name: orange-neptune-contact-lambda
description: Contact form handler — validates the submission and emails the lead via Amazon SES.

scripts.package: rm -f function.zip && zip -r function.zip index.mjs node_modules package.json
scripts.deploy: npm run package && aws lambda update-function-code --region ap-northeast-1 --function-name orange-neptune-contact --zip-file fileb://function.zip
